cards.card_text: True or false: Jesus calls them workers of lawlessness and tells them to depart from Him.
cards.verse_text: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’
cards.snippet: …them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’

cards.card_text: Every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness Every worry and all who live in fear Every sickness and all who live in pain
cards.verse_text: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will weed out of His kingdom every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness.
cards.snippet: …out of His kingdom every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness.

cards.card_text: Paul is clear: "Let no one deceive you in any way…" That Day won't come until the rebellion happens and the man of lawlessness, the son of destruction, is revealed.
cards.verse_text: Let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness—the son of destruction—is revealed.
cards.snippet: …it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness—the son of destruction—is revealed.

cards.card_text: Paul says the mystery of lawlessness is ALREADY at work.
cards.verse_text: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will continue until he is taken out of the way.
cards.snippet: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will…

cards.card_text: Paul says someone is restraining lawlessness right now.
cards.verse_text: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will continue until he is taken out of the way.
cards.snippet: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will…

cards.verse_text: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.
cards.snippet: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous…

cards.card_text: He practices lawlessness as well He has only made a mistake He is still learning the law
cards.verse_text: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well.
cards.snippet: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well.

cards.card_text: Then he puts it flat: sin is lawlessness.
cards.verse_text: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well.
cards.snippet: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well.
